MANDATORY PRODUCT REFERENCE & FIDELITY:
- Use the uploaded original product image as a mandatory visual reference, not merely as loose inspiration.
- Preserve the exact product identity and appearance: its shape, proportions, colors, materials, distinctive details, and design must match the uploaded reference image.
- Do NOT replace the product with a similar-looking alternative, redesign it, alter its appearance, or invent features/accessories.
- The product depicted in the final Pinterest creative must clearly and unmistakably be the exact same product as in the reference image.
- The product may be placed in an attractive lifestyle or promotional setting, but the product itself must remain completely faithful to the reference.

VISUAL FOCUS & ART DIRECTION:
- The primary visual hero is the authentic referenced product.
- Professional commercial advertising studio art direction with high-end lighting and clean composition.
- Polished, premium gift presentation with warm inviting aesthetic and clean commercial composition. The product is the prominent hero, staged with thoughtful gift appeal.

gift_inspiration.visual_direction: Polished, premium gift presentation with warm inviting aesthetic and clean commercial composition. The product is the prominent hero, staged with thoughtful gift appeal.
verified_facts: Softness: Ultra-soft, breathable, and high-stretch fabric made from 88% polyester and 12% spandex feels buttery soft against your skin. Lightweight yet substantial enough to resist turning sheer, it moves with you and maintains shape after stretching

Flattering: Slim-fit crew neck design hugs your body comfortably without feeling tight. The smooth, flat neckline creates a clean look and sits comfortably against the skin, while light shaping helps smooth your midsection for a streamlined shape

Easy Care & Fit Tips: For the right fit, please check the size chart before ordering. Machine wash cold on gentle cycle with like colors. Do not bleach or iron. The fabric stays soft, comfortable, and keeps its shape through everyday wear
